Zones 1–25 from Peter's numbered markup (Oct 8), boundaries per Zones.pdf (Oct 19). Zones 14 (change rooms), 15 (theatre), 16 (gym) and 24 (Mech 201) run as their own trains. Corridor zones C1, C3 and C4 run last in the main train; Zone boundaries follow Peter's Zones.pdf markup (Oct 19); uncoloured corridors are zones C1 (L1 classroom wing) and C4 (L2). Washroom train: 9 groups W1–W9, ordered to trail the main train; small W/Cs (W1, W2, W3, W5) run 4-day wagons. Elec 112, Data 107/132/144C and Wiring 150H are shown as their own trains. Holds: zone 5 T-bar Dec 1, zone 6 T-bar Dec 15, zone 20 T-bar Dec 1, zones 10–13 drywall Nov 30, zone 14 finishes Dec 1; gym priming fixed Oct 26–30. Dates come from Master Takt Plan v4 (rev 4 zones, T-bar flow): 4-day takt, data date Sep 29, Sep update + 25 points, FAVI after the last millwork wagon. Density = composite of 13 remaining scopes against the main-train zone average. Plan north points to the right of the drawings. Interior walls are traced from room boundaries on the IFC plans; door openings are not cut. Storey height 4.6 m. Stairs are schematic. Finishes: wall, floor, base and ceiling finishes from the A8.00 room finish schedule; ceiling assembly tags (C1–C8) and heights from the reflected ceiling plans; floor assemblies from the A0 assembly schedule; millwork from unit tags on the interior elevations.
